question: Which of the following ratios is greatest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare fractions by **decimal approximation** or **numerator-denominator gaps**.

Ratio 1 = 41/64 ≈ 0.64

Ratio 2 = 50/59 ≈ 0.84

Ratio 3 = 40/70 ≈ 0.57

Ratio 4 = 26/90 ≈ 0.28

**∴ The correct answer is 50 : 59.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48601299a2e6e1bd38dd11ac882976d8d1d97cac757833d63ede216bf750b111.png] 

**Given:** Ratios are 41/64, 50/59, 40/70, and 26/90.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 41 ÷ 64 = 0.6406

⇒ 50 ÷ 59 = 0.8474

⇒ 40 ÷ 70 = 0.5714

⇒ 26 ÷ 90 = 0.2888

⇒ Comparing values: 0.8474 > 0.6406 > 0.5714 > 0.2888

**∴ The correct answer is 50 : 59.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cross Multiplication Method

To compare a/b and c/d, check the product of a × d and b × c. If ad > bc, then a/b > c/d.

Gap Method

If the difference between numerator and denominator is small relative to the values, the ratio is closer to 1 (higher value).

Percentage Conversion

Multiply the ratio by 100 to find the percentage equivalent; the highest percentage represents the greatest ratio.</p
